item.title: Shannon Creche Says Govt Plans To Lower Childcare Fees “Won’t Work”
item.description: A Shannon Creche has poured cold water on new state proposals to lower childcare costs for struggling parents. item.title: Council On Course To Deliver Over 230 Social And Affordable Homes This Year
item.description: Clare County Council is on course to deliver 232 social and affordable homes this year, with the support of local developers and in partnership with Approved Housing Bodies. item.title: World’s Largest Passenger Aircraft Touches Down In Shannon
item.description: The world’s largest passenger aircraft made a spectacular landing on Ireland’s longest runway today as the Lufthansa Airbus A380 touched down at Shannon Airport.
